title: Phase 1 — Global Shell, Fuzzy Topbar Search, Zero Backend Telemetry & Audience UX
exitCriteria: Global Topbar Search supports /, Enter, and Esc; duplicate topbar Import and dead CSS removed; zero backend telemetry strings remain in Shell/Audience; Audience UI/UX surfaces (Brand Header, Sidebar, Audience Audit, Profile Scout, WorkspaceOverview) updated and type-check/build pass.

title: Phase 2 — 4-Tier Animation System, Single-Line Headers, Symbolic Icons & Frosted Glass
exitCriteria: 4-Tier Motion System (_motion-tokens.scss, @formkit/auto-animate) active with prefers-reduced-motion support; UiCard enforces single-line icon + title headers; frosted --glass-bg SCSS applied across workspace cards/modals; Symbolic Icon Status System (reka-ui tooltips) and shared vue-sonner toast host active.

title: Phase 3 — Planner/Connections De-Duplication & Create Studios Simplification
exitCriteria: availablePlatformIds re-selection bug fixed; Planner channel selector separated from Preview; PublisherNavbar single-line; nested details flattened; Queue & Content Studio bound to Global Search; Connections card actions iconified; Script Studio consolidated to one header.

title: Phase 4 — Operate & Build Workspaces Collapsible Consolidation
exitCriteria: Engage uses 2-pane layout with toggleable Add drawer; Workflows displays 3-layer Visual Bot status strip; BrandProfileModal is tabbed and <150 lines; Automation Studio builder collapses cleanly; Design System, Asset Manager & Android Build Studio use single-line headers and collapsed diagnostics.

title: Phase 5 — Layered Backend Organization, SQLite Single-Truth, Validation & Redaction
exitCriteria: server/http/ (rou3 router, valibot schemas, fast-redact logger) active; orchestrator stale in-memory arrays replaced by SQLite WAL repositories; server/jobs/ uses p-queue with fail-closed human approval; oversized server/routes, server/marketing, and server/engine files split <150 lines; all server tests pass.

title: Phase 6 — Unified Dev Maintenance Supervisor & Live 3-Layer Visual Bot
exitCriteria: dev-supervisor.ts and diagnostics.mjs unified into npm run dev:doctor (--json, --ci, --ensure, --full, --visual-bot) with Node DEP0190 fixed; automated ui-hygiene-check.mjs gate active; live 3-layer Visual Bot + Playwright/axe-core checks pass; wired into .github/workflows/ci.yml.

title: Phase 7 — Dead Prototype Cleanup, <150-Line Modularity & 5-Width Release Gate
exitCriteria: Dormant unmounted prototypes archived/removed; npm run check:file-size reports 0 violations across src/, server/, extension/, scripts/, and test/; zero horizontal overflow and WCAG AA checks verified at 360/390/768/1024/1280 CSS px; npm run verify and npm run planning:check pass.
